name: wpr-jobs: Pages deploy failing, jobs board stale
what: Deploy to GitHub Pages has failed twice since July 4; step 'Run actions/deploy-pages@v4' fails, so the published board hasn't updated in ~12 weeks.
pitch: The Stripe-paid jobs board shows nearly three months of stale listings; employers pay for postings readers never see, and refund requests become likely.

name: wpr-property-transactions: scraper and price history both failing
what: price-history failing since August 2 and scrape-transactions since August 13, each twice; no new transaction data for roughly six weeks.
pitch: The property tracker is stale on site, and Ledger Brief plus Sponsor Leads digests lose their transaction input — breakage spreads to both email products.

name: wpr-events: scheduled deploy disabled by GitHub
what: Build & Deploy was switched off by GitHub after 60 days without repo activity; the calendar has not rebuilt since.
pitch: The events calendar embedded in WordPress silently stops refreshing, so readers see past or missing events with no error anywhere to signal it.

name: wpr-immunity-ledger: weekly deploy stopped firing
what: Build and deploy last ran 26 days ago despite a 168-hour schedule still in the workflow file; roughly three runs missed.
pitch: A live Ledger tracker is 26 days stale for readers, and the Ledger Brief and Sponsor Leads digests draw on outdated ledger data.

name: wpr-cleanup-ledger: quarterly bulk ingest failing
what: Quarterly bulk ingest failed on September 25 in job 'attempt-2 / quarterly', at a step that exits 1 when FAIL_AFTER_REACH is true.
pitch: The quarterly ledger refresh did not land, so the cleanup ledger page and the digests that read it miss this quarter's records.

name: wpr-brewers-tracker: prospect rankings check failing
what: Prospect rankings check failed once on September 1 at step 'Compare config with MLB Pipeline'; unchecked since.
pitch: The sports widget can drift out of sync with MLB's prospect list, so readers see outdated Brewers rankings with no warning.

name: wpr-trails: weekly pipeline failing for three months
what: Weekly Pipeline has failed 13 straight runs since June 28, always at step 'Pull source data'; output stale ~13 weeks.
pitch: Trail data has been frozen since June; low direct revenue impact, but the failing cron adds noise that hides more urgent breakages.

name: racine-obit-demo: Pages build failing
what: pages-build-deployment has failed three times since July 2 at step 'Deploy to GitHub Pages'.
pitch: A demo repo, so no reader or revenue impact; it only clutters the failure list each week until archived or fixed.
